fields.name: bias_types
fields.definition: Categories of social or representation bias explicitly discussed in relation to LLMs or generative AI, as observed findings or potential risks. Return each independent category separately. Fairness indicators, bias sources and mitigation strategies are not bias types.

fields.name: software_engineering_tasks_or_contexts
fields.definition: Application tasks or use contexts of LLMs or generative AI explicitly connected to bias or fairness, whether evaluated or proposed. Describe what the system is used to do. Internal pipeline construction, configuration, orchestration and infrastructure are not application tasks merely because they support the system.

fields.name: llm_systems
fields.definition: Identifiable LLMs, assistants or generative systems actually evaluated as subjects of the study's bias analysis. Generic model categories, proposed architecture components, training techniques and auxiliary tools do not qualify on mention alone.

fields.name: bias_sources
fields.definition: Factors explicitly asserted or hypothesized by the authors to originate, reintroduce or amplify bias. Accept the level of detail stated in the article, including broad factors; further specificity or empirical proof is not required. Return independent factors separately and preserve their asserted or hypothesized status.

fields.name: evaluation_methods
fields.definition: Methods, datasets or indicators explicitly proposed or used to detect or evaluate bias or fairness. Preserve whether each is proposed or actually used. General performance, security or efficiency measures do not qualify without an explicit bias-evaluation role.

fields.name: reported_impacts
fields.definition: Consequences explicitly attributed by the authors to bias in LLMs or applications using LLMs, including potential harms, background claims and observed consequences for people, groups, activities or the use of these systems. A concrete connection to LLMs must be supported by the article; examples concerning other AI systems alone do not qualify. Preserve the claim status and return independent consequences separately. Biased output patterns or group disparities themselves belong to manifestations; do not infer downstream harms from them. Bias sources, detection metrics and unrelated security or explainability concerns are not impacts of bias.

fields.name: manifestations
fields.definition: Concrete ways bias appears in LLM or generative-AI outputs or behavior, including stereotyped content, demographic skew, differential recommendations and performance disparities between groups. Include observed patterns and explicitly discussed potential patterns, preserving that distinction. Return independent manifestations separately. Bias category names alone, causes, downstream consequences and metric names alone are not manifestations. Do not infer a manifestation solely from a proposed metric or mitigation strategy.

fields.name: mitigation_strategies
fields.definition: Interventions proposed, implemented or evaluated to reduce or prevent bias; preserve the stated claim status. Return independent strategies separately. An umbrella strategy may retain its explicitly named examples in one item. General security, efficiency or alignment mechanisms require a supported connection to bias mitigation.
